praise: Palette is unmistakably this business — chocolate brown, gold, cream over a cream background with fine grain — disciplined, no gradient soup, and the dark hero + stats anchor the page between warm light sections.
Fraunces/Inter pairing is a confident, considered choice; h1 clamp(2.6rem,7.2vw,4.6rem) with tight tracking carries weight, and short-copy cards stay scannable.
Copy is local and specific: real street address, real phone, '4.9 · 34 Google reviews', 'dialed in daily', 'gone by noon', genuine-seeming review quotes — no lorem, no welcome-fluff.
One-visit test passes outright: business name, offer and phone are reachable from the topbar, header, hero, about card, banner and footer within 10 seconds.
